verdict.rationale: Rippling's payroll docs say it automatically calculates payroll taxes and files them with the correct federal, state, and local agencies at the right time. The global payroll page repeats the calculate-and-file claim. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of tax payment remittance (only filing is stated), independent or hands-on corroboration of automated tax filing.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can have federal, state, and local payroll taxes calculated, filed, and remitted automatically

citations.quote: We automatically calculate payroll taxes and file them with the correct federal, state, and local agencies at precisely the right time.
Rippling instantly calculates and files payroll taxes for your employees worldwide.
